quest.title: Those We Have Kept
quest.description: The film premiere is a success, and she seems to have changed much...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Vagrancy x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: As expected, going to the opera house is the true way to enjoy a film!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: You get to see the audience's reaction in real time too. The ending seemed to be received quite well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't believe you let us include that in the final cut, Sandrone!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: You even agreed to help us reshoot a couple of shots! Thanks a million!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph, most of it was caught on Kamera already, so it's not like I had much of a choice. Besides, no film I'm in is going to be anything less than perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...What are you laughing at?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Nothing. It was just interesting to see us on screen together.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I'm glad this moment is going to be preserved forever.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Just a pity we didn't take home the Furina Award this time around...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Well, artistic films can rarely compete with commercial ones. You should have prepared yourself for this the minute you changed the script.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Haha... True...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Ooo-ooo-ooh? Did I hear someone mention the Furina Award?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon. Don't gloat.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hehe, I won't. Our crew winning the Furina Award was a team effort, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Costume design, script adaptation... Ooh! And the practical effects were so realistic! The flames and explosions even made me jump while we were filming!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: A lot of the effects were based on actual items the Special Patrol confiscated from criminals. Who knew they'd serve another purpose, right?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: But it turned out amazing! Really brought the thrilling scenes from the novel to life. Fontaine's film industry is seriously impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which film did you vote for, Citlali?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Uh, isn't it obvious? "Great Detective Hurlock," of course! That's the whole reason I'm here!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: You all should be proud, though! A lot of critics are saying really good things about your film too!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Longing and loss, searching for something even after it's gone... It's a film that makes you think about life, and how important it is to explore those themes!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Well, that is what the art of storytelling is for.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, watching a film with friends is so much fun! There's so much to talk about!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Let's throw a celebration later then! We're all old friends. We can find a place and chat to our hearts' content!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: How about the Wingalet?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: That's perfect! Friends and family are more than welcome too! So, if you want to bring people, don't be shy!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You all can head over first and make yourselves at home. I'll bring over some refreshments in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I just have one more stop to make first...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Can I come?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Us too?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph, fine. Not like you'd listen if I tried to stop you.

talks.objective: Go to the place Sandrone wishes to head to
Go to the place Sandrone wishes to head to

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... Is this...?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Yes. Here lies "Lord-Artificer," Alain Guillotin. This is his grave.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... Alain. I'm sorry this is the first time I've been back since leaving Fontaine. I should have come to see you more often.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I got your "gift." Heh... I even cleaned up one of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's messes along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Our home is just as quiet and warm as it always was. The flowers in the garden are still thriving. I'll make sure to tend to them more often from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Pulonia... received irreparable damage in battle. I should have taken better care of your invention. I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Pulonia was family to me... just like you.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You always said I was a fast learner... but I'm not so sure. It took me far too long to learn the things that truly matter...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I never said this to you back then, but... thank you for creating me, for giving me the chance to experience life.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Being your family meant everything to me. Absolutely everything...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Can I say a few words as well, Sandrone?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph... don't need my permission...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hello, Mr. Guillotin. I'm Sandrone's friend.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You don't need to worry. Sandrone is doing great.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Not only is she a brilliant scholar, she's made a whole bunch of friends too. And she takes great care of them.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: As if...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: She'll never admit it, but she's always there when her friends need it the most. I wouldn't even be here without her.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: So, if she ever needs help, her friends will be there in a heartbeat, including me. That's what best friends are for.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Columbina...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: What else... Oh! She likes drinking bitter coffee, listening to piano music when she can't sleep... Turns out she even likes giving hugs...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: No, wait! Don't tell him all that!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Huh? I don't understand. I didn't think you'd want to hide things from him.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Well, yeah. But there are still things I don't want to say!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Okay. I'll come by myself and tell him for you then.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: That's not what I meant!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Tch, alright. Enough with the speeches. If no one has anything else to add, let's just leave it there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm, should we say a few words too? Kinda seems like Columbina said it all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's leave a flower.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Great idea!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Goodbye, Alain.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Ah, you made it! The party's already started.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Oh, but, uh, you didn't bring anyone else along? I thought you headed out to invite some friends?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: We did invite a friend, actually. She'll be here soon. She's even bringing some desserts to have over tea. You should join us later, Miss Furina.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: I do love a tea party... Then, don't mind if I do!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: This seems like a fun occasion. Let's go talk with everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good idea! We'll introduce you to all our old friends!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: You made it! Sorry for starting the celebrations without you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No worries at all! We're just glad everyone's having such a great time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right! You've probably seen them around already, but let us introduce you for real. This is—

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Miss Columbina and Miss Guillotin, right? Haha, we saw the film you were in! It was so touching!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Yep. This one started bawling her eyes out right next to me in the theatre.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I know! I didn't bring nearly enough tissues!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Thanks. We saw your film too. I memorized all your names.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, guess we can skip the introductions then...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Hehe! Our effects were pretty over-the-top, right? Some of the extras in the big scenes were actual members of the Spina di Rosula!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: So basically, your contribution was creating realistic-looking chaos.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Heh, that wasn't the only realistic aspect... Miss Chevreuse and Miss Emilie were also kind enough to lend their expertise on criminal investigations and forensics.

dialogues.speaker: Emilie
dialogues.text: Oh, it was nothing. I was just honored to take part and help out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, no wonder your film turned out so good... You basically had an expert in every field! Talk about a stacked crew...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh, speaking of... Want to join in on a round of Tabletop Troupe later, Miss Columbina and Miss Guillotin? I mean, what better place for a party... than a party, hehehe!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Here we go again...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That sounds interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Yes! Persuasion successful! What about you, Miss Guillotin?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Uh... I guess one round couldn't hurt...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Haha, critical success!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second... Mr. Baptiste and Veronique! You're here!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Friends of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Veronique is the prop manager for Musketeer Pictures! And Mr. Baptiste is the author of "The Two Musketeers"!

dialogues.speaker: Veronique
dialogues.text: Aha... Yeah, "former" prop manager. Now we're just two criminals serving our time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How've you been?

dialogues.speaker: Veronique
dialogues.text: Thanks to Duke Wriothesley and Nurse Sigewinne looking out for us, not too bad actually.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You make it sound like I'm giving you special treatment. I just think the method of "justice" you chose to pursue is one people can respect.

dialogues.speaker: Baptiste
dialogues.text: You're far too modest, Your Grace. The only reason we were even able to come to the surface for the festival is because you fought for it.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: It's also just good for the physical and mental health of the prisoners in general.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Anyway, I suppose I have you to thank for keeping the Wingalet in such good shape! I never knew she could look so striking.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: #I didn't do anything special. It was mostly {NICKNAME} and the others.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Don't sell yourself short, Miss Guillotin. You are the current captain, after all. In light of that, I have to ask...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Do you mind if I leave up some of the installations so the people back at the Fortress can also enjoy the aquarium?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Like I said before, I just think it would be good for the inmates who clean and maintain the Wingalet to see their work put to good use.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Besides, maintaining an aquarium is sure to be a lot more interesting than scrubbing rust off the walls and deck.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Oh... Of course I don't mind. I'm grateful you even want to keep it.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Great, then it's decided.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: That's amazing, Sandrone. We should go hang out at the Fortress of Meropide later, then!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...You do know you just invited me to hang out in prison, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: *sob*... What a dream come true... For once, it all worked out... I can die without regrets...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Uh, haha... Let's not get too ahead of ourselves, Director Lepine-Pauline!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: What was in that piece of cake you just handed her, Escoffier?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Romaritime flowers, eggs, flour... same as all the other pieces. What, you think I tampered with it? Playing a detective in real life now too, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: It's so delicious... I'm so happy... My life has peaked... *sob*...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Miss Lepine-Pauline, look who I brought!

dialogues.speaker: Ninette
dialogues.text: Master!

dialogues.speaker: Ninette
dialogues.text: Wait... What happened to your face? Why are you crying?

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Never mind my face! Here, let me introduce you. This is Miss Charlotte and Miss Escoffier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Things are sounding lively over here!

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Oh, look who it is! Perfect timing! I was so busy with the shoot, I feel like we barely got to talk!

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Ah! And the elusive Miss Guillotin! It's great to see you! Thank you so much for letting us use the boat free of charge. That was so generous of you!

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Oh, right! Introductions! This is Miss Charlotte and Miss Escoffier...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: That's kind of you, but I didn't really do anything. If you want to thank someone, it should be the Duke or the people who keep the boat in such good shape.

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Right, right... I'll head over in a bit and do just that!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Miss Columbina...?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Could I... interview you sometime? I'll treat you to some Gateau Debord for the trouble! There's only a limited amount available each day, but it's an absolute must-try when you're in Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Oh... Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Bold of you to use my own cake as a bribe right in front of me...

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: You know what? When else are we all going to be together like this? C'mon, everyone. Grab your drinks!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Are we going to toast?

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Yep! C'mon, c'mon, c'mon! Sante!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Granny Itztli, you're really not going to let us borrow these cute little stuffed toys for our magic show?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: First of all, Citlalin and Itzpapa are Tzitzimitl! They have inauspicious stars sealed within them, and they're my helpers, not toys!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: But... the Grin-Malkin Cat and Bogglecat Box are Lyney and Lynette's helpers, and they still make good partners on stage.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Agreed. We've never had a Tzitzimitl pop out of our hats before. It would be quite the surprise. I think the audience would love it.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: (Ugh... If this was the Masters of the Night-Wind, these kids wouldn't have even had the guts to say my name, let alone pester me like this...)

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: #(I'm terrible at dealing with requests like this... Oh! {NICKNAME}! Quick, save me!)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like Granny Itztli's made some new friends!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: You think you're so funny!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Lady Sandrone, Lady Columbina.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Don't look at me like that. I don't have any mechanisms for you to break!

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Hehe... Don't be fooled by my sister's demeanor, Lady Sandrone. She's just as delighted as the rest of us to have you back.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph, well... I suppose when I'm not so busy, I could find some time when Arlecchino is around, and bring over a few gifts to the House of the Hearth.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: You're too kind, Lady Sandrone. I'm sure just your visit alone would make "Father" more than happy.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I just need to borrow them for a bit. I'll pull them out of my hat, give them a quick hug, then give them straight back.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: When did hugging become a part of it!?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Oh! I could lend you Pers, so you have something to hug in the meantime. He gives really good hugs...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: I don't need something to hug in the meantime! The issue was never the hugs!

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Mm, how about this... You can have two VIP tickets right next to each other. Excellent view!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Right next to each other?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Yep. Super quiet. No one will bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I'm sure you'll have a great time.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Neuvillette! You came to the celebration too!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Yes. I can only hope my presence does not make anyone ill at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Who's this...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right! This is Neuvillette, the Iudex of Fontaine. And this is Columbina and Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: (These two must be the Fatuus and former Fatuus related to the recent incident in Nod-Krai. I read about them in the diplomatic report...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: The Iudex? Oh, the dragon that cries a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Oh, well...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Geez, Columbina... That's your takeaway from all those Fatui meetings. Seriously...?)

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: (Is that truly how I'm portrayed in the Fatui's intelligence?)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You must put a lot of people in prison, then...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Well, it would be more accurate to say I pass judgment on their crimes. All trials in Fontaine strive for fairness and justice, so as to avoid imprisoning the innocent.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: So... only the people who deserve it get sent to prison.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Well, "deserve" is quite a subjective metric, is it not? At the very least, I can promise that, in every trial over which I preside, I make every effort to deliver a fair verdict.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hm...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...Hya!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Oh, for the love of— What is she doing now!?)

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Uhm...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: You seem like a good per— uhm, dragon. Not the kind that throws people in prison for no reason.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I think we can get along just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Ah, well... Thank you...?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: (Then, she punched me because...?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry, Neuvillette! She thinks that's a sign of friendship...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Where does she even pick up weird habits like that...?)

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Ah... I see. I believe I have observed people on the streets of Fontaine expressing affection in a similar manner.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I suppose I now know what it feels like. Hm, yes. Quite... abrupt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, these two are surprisingly alike...

talks.objective: Take a photo with your friends

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Alright, Musketeer Pictures. Everyone ready?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I'm not sure I should be in this one...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Of course you should! You might have primarily helped out another crew this time, but you're still a member of Musketeer Pictures!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Alright, thanks. I'll still stand a bit off to the side, though.

dialogues.speaker: Veronique
dialogues.text: Can I be in the picture too?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Of course, Miss Veronique. I would have loved to have you in the last one too, if circumstances had allowed it.

dialogues.speaker: Veronique
dialogues.text: Thank you... Director Xavier.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Ugh... do I really have to be front and center?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're one of the lead actors! Of course you do!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Nervous, Sandrone?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Tch, no!

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Alright, look at the kamera...

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: And three, two, one...

dialogues.speaker: Everyone
dialogues.text: "Musketeer Pictures!"

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Well, it's been quite some time since the three of us gathered to drink tea like this...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Yes, but your tea is as good as ever, Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph, of course it is. The pastries you brought aren't half bad either, Arlecchino.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: I'm glad to hear it.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Are they to your liking, Miss Furina? If I remember correctly, this particular cake is your favorite.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Yes, thank you. The tea and pastries are absolutely delicious.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: (Hehe, I can't believe I'm casually sipping tea with three Harbingers... or are some of them former Harbingers? Who knows...)

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: Due to diplomatic reasons at the time, our last tea party was rather tense, wasn't it, Miss Furina? You have my apologies.

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: But, this is simply a casual gathering of close friends. So, I do hope you can relax and enjoy yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Of course! I appreciate the hospitality... in both cases! Next time, let me be the one to treat all of you!

dialogues.speaker: The Knave
dialogues.text: I'm sure we'd all be delighted to have you join us more often. The same goes for you two.

choices.text: Just keep the pastries coming, and we'll be there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course we should do this again! We've all been through thick and thin together by this point!

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Hehe... This is nice, Sandrone. It reminds me of the happy times back in Snezhnaya. When things were so lively...

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Yeah. To be honest, I never thought these gatherings would feel this lively ever again.

response.speaker: The Knave
response.text: Well, I think I speak for all of us when I say, we're truly glad you're back, Sandrone.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Me too. I've realized that holding on to what matters doesn't just mean protecting what you already have.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: By reaching out and striving for something new, you can gain much more than you think.

response.speaker: The Knave
response.text: Now, that certainly doesn't sound like something the old you would say.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: W—Well, I'm only going to say it once, so... don't get used to it!

response.speaker: The Knave
response.text: Heh, who knows? Perhaps your tea parties will only get livelier from here on out.

response.speaker: The Knave
response.text: Once you return to the Fatui, we'll have more opportunities to keep in touch, in any case.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Hmm... I want to spend more time together too, but I don't want to go back to the Fatui.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Well, Nod-Krai isn't too far from Snezhnograd. It shouldn't be hard to find a place where we can all get together.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Ooh! And then I can sing for you, or put on some of your favorite music, just like the old days!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Ah, speaking of music... I spotted a mechanical piano below deck. Is it yours, Miss Guillotin?

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Yes. Reclaimed... I suppose you could say.

response.speaker: The Knave
response.text: Why don't you play something for us?

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: ...Huh? In front of all these people!?

response.speaker: Columbina
